Falindar Gope ... Petitioner
 Versus

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava
For the Petitioner : Mr. K.S. Nanda, Adv.
: Mr. Niranjan Kr. Sinha, Adv.
For the State : Mr. Tarun Kumar, A.P.P.

For the Informant : Ms. Shreya Tiwari, Adv.
Order No.07/Dated- 12.07.2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner has been made accused in connection with S.T. Case No. 06 of 2024 arising out of Rania P.S. Case No. 49 of 2023 (G.R. Case No. 710 of 2023) registered for offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 323, 406, 504 of the I.P.C. which is pending in the Court of Learned District and Additional Sessions Judge-I, Khunti.

3. As per F.I.R., the petitioner made sexual relationship against the will of the victim while her mother was absent and threatened her to face dire consequences if she discloses the same with anyone.
Subsequently, on the pretext of marriage, he repeatedly making sexual relationship

,
resultantly, the victim got pregnant in the year 2020.

The victim given birth to a child and the petitioner refused to marry the victim rather brought another lady and directed her to return her house along with her child.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner and the victim was under love relationship with each other since year, 2020 and the victim given birth to one child before marriage.
Due to some differences, marriage could not be solemnized, but now petitioner and the victim are desirous to solemnize marriage with each other and legalize their relationship.
Petitioner is in judicial custody since 27.09.2023.

Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the trial of the case and to remain physically present on each and every date till the conclusion of the trial and shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidence or influence the witnesses or gain over them.
Hence, the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.

5. Learned Addl. P.P. appeared and learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 (victim) has also present and admits that settlement arrived at between the parties, but since the petitioner is in judicial custody, no further steps have been towards solemnizing marriage.

7. Considering the aforementioned facts and circumstances, petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty-five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Learned District and Additional Sessions Judge-I, Khunti in connection with S.T. Case No. 06 of 2024 arising out of Rania P.S. Case No. 49 of 2023 (G.R. Case No. 710 of 2023) subject to the conditions:
(1). Petitioner shall remain physically present on each and every date till the conclusion of the trial of this case unless prevented from sufficient cause to the satisfaction of the Learned Trial Court.
(2). Petitioner shall not indulge in any or other similar offence till the conclusion of the trial.
(3). Petitioner shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidences or influencing the prosecution witnesses.
8. In case of violation of the aforesaid conditions, the bail of the petitioner shall be cancelled and shall be taken into custody by the Learned Trial Court.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Amar/-
